title: Effect of fluorinated arylammonium halide passivation in chloride–iodide perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00164A, Paper

Ashraful Hossain Howlader, Yin Yao, Rhiannon Kuchel, Ashraf Uddin
The PSC exhibits both bulk and surface defect passivation using mixed aromatic halides. It is highly efficient (21.10%) and stable (80%) after 58 days with a higher fill factor (76.44%), lower trap density states (1015 cm−3), and lower hysteresis.
